name: [UPD 1.5.9] WW3 Commander
desc:
Welcome to WW3 Commander!

⭐ Gameplay:

• Buy engineers to build and develop your nation 🏗️
• Upgrade engineers to increase construction speed and boost your economy 💰
• Buy missiles, lock on, and attack other players 🚀
• Build air defense systems to intercept enemy missile attacks 🛡️
• Attack pirate islands to earn extra rewards and resources 🏴‍☠️

🎖️ Can you become the strongest WW3 Commander?

• Build a powerful economy and rapidly develop your nation.
• Balance offense and defense to become an unstoppable commander.

👍 If you enjoy the game, please give us a like and add it to your favorites!
